preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 4 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of roads k must be between n-1 and 2n-2 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= n and 1 <= d <= n
preconditions.description: Cities a, b, c, and d must be between 1 and n inclusive.
Cities a, b, c, and d must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(paths) == 2 and len(paths[0]) == n and len(paths[1]) == n and paths[0][0] == a and paths[0][-1] == b and paths[1][0] == c and paths[1][-1] == d and len(set([tuple(sorted(edge)) for path in paths for edge in zip(path, path[1:])])) <= k)
postconditions.description: The output must be '-1' if no valid paths exist, otherwise it must contain two paths of length n each, starting and ending at the specified cities, and the total number of distinct roads must not exceed k.
